---
title: "A Gardener Needs"
---

::: {.columns .poem-columns}
::: {.column width="44%"}
::: {.speaker .speaker-a}
| A Gardener needs
| They need plants and robots
| and spades and lasers
| to grow... to grow...
| weeds! and flowers
| and fruit and peanuts
| and vines and gourds
| and cabbage and mint
| Ah Kinder, but most
| of all they need
| Patience
| And a friend who likes jam.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="28%"}
::: {.speaker .speaker-b}
| What do they need Gran?
| Granny! Granny!
| she said a naughty word!
| What do they need Gran?
:::
:::

::: {.column width="28%"}
::: {.speaker .speaker-c}
| I know! I know!
:::
:::
:::

by  
Patrick Barry
